messages:
ivy: Quick proposal: set default SIEM export retention for external partner snapshots to 21 days (was 90). Need RBAC gating, KMS JIT-unlock, and a clear legal_hold flow. @noah @rachel
noah: 21d sounds reasonable as a default. We need a simple exception path and an auditable approval chain.
rachel: RBAC sketch: roles `export.requester`, `export.approver`, `export.executor`. Executor is a tiny svc allowlist that calls the KMS-unlock proxy. Approver toggles approved=true on the request record.
ivy: KMS proxy idea: proxy accepts request_id after approval, verifies request.approved && request.legal_hold==false, then calls KMS:Decrypt with EncryptionContext.request_id and returns an ephemeral unwrap token (TTL=10m) to executor. All decrypts logged to CloudTrail + SIEM event `export.unseal` with request_id.
legal-sam: Legal: require two approvers if request.legal_hold==true (legal + security). While legal_hold is set, automated unwraps are blocked and request metadata is immutable. Release must record approver IDs and justification.
noah: DLP gating: add `contains_sensitive` checkbox and `data_class` (PII/Auth/Payment). If true, pipeline writes to quarantined bucket path and DLP must pass before external upload. Approver must re-approve after DLP.
ivy: Minimal request fields: request_id, requester, scope, justification, retention_days (default 21, max 365 or legal_hold), contains_sensitive, data_class, approver, audit_links.
noah: CLI stub for triage:
`rw logs export request --scope "auth*:2026-03-10..2026-03-11" --retention 21 --justification "partner triage" --requester ivy@redwood.ai`
ops-bot: ticket SEC-2026-8102 created: export-retention-21d-and-jit-unlock. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-8102
ivy: Action items: noah -> KMS proxy + CMK condition draft; rachel -> RBAC PR for roles + allowlist; legal-sam -> legal_hold release checklist. Sync tomorrow 10:30. :thumbsup:
